title: Why Did Gatorade Bottles Get Smaller?
description:
Gatorade's 32-ounce bottle became 28 ounces at the same price, and the company's explanation was that the new shape is more aerodynamic.
#gatorade #shrinkflation #money #shorts

Sources: Quartz via World Economic Forum (Mar 2022); AP via GPB (Jun 8, 2022); Sen. Bob Casey shrinkflation report (Dec 2023); Business Insider (Mar 2022); KSL (Mar 8, 2022); KOMO News (Mar 17, 2022); Mental Floss (Mar 2022)
Photos: JeepersMedia (Mike Mozart), m01229 (CC BY 2.0, Flickr)
tags: why did gatorade bottles get smaller
first_comment: Be honest: do you check the ounces, or just the price? 👀

scenes.say: Your Gatorade shrank four ounces. The price didn't.
scenes.source: Quartz via World Economic Forum Mar 2022 (32 oz to 28 oz at the same price); Sen. Casey report Dec 2023 (Gatorade 32 oz to 28 oz, same price); AP via GPB Jun 2022 (32 oz bottles phased out for 28 oz)

scenes.say: {32|Thirty two} ounces became {28|twenty eight}, same price.
scenes.source: Quartz via WEF Mar 2022; Sen. Casey report Dec 2023; KSL Mar 8 2022 (32 fl oz reduced to 28 fl oz)

scenes.say: That's a hidden {14%|fourteen percent} price hike.
scenes.source: Quartz via WEF Mar 2022 (equates to a 14% price increase); Business Insider Mar 2022 (price increase of about 14%); arithmetic 32/28 = 1.143

scenes.say: The company's explanation? The new bottle is more aerodynamic and easier to grab.

visual.quote: Basically we redesigned the bottle, it's more aerodynamic and it's easier to grab.

scenes.source: Quartz via World Economic Forum Mar 22 2022, verbatim company representative quote; repeated in Business Insider Mar 2022 via Quartz

scenes.say: Doritos did it too. Five fewer chips per bag.
scenes.source: KOMO News Mar 17 2022 (9.75 oz to 9.25 oz, an average of five fewer chips, Frito-Lay confirmed); Mental Floss Mar 2022 (roughly five fewer chips, price unchanged); Sen. Casey report Dec 2023 (9.75 oz to 9.25 oz)

scenes.say: Charmin's Mega roll lost twenty sheets.
scenes.source: Sen. Casey report Dec 2023 (Charmin Ultra Soft Mega 264 sheets to 244); KSL Mar 8 2022 citing Edgar Dworsky (264 to 244 two-ply sheets per roll)

scenes.say: It's called shrinkflation, and it works because you watch the price, not the size.
scenes.source: KOMO News Mar 2022 (Cornell's Andrew Novakovic: people pay attention to price and often don't notice a size change); ConsumerWorld definition via KOMO

scenes.say: And once a product shrinks, it rarely grows back.
scenes.source: AP via GPB Jun 8 2022 (consumer advocate Edgar Dworsky: upsizing is rare, once a product shrinks it usually stays smaller)

scenes.say: So check the unit price on the shelf tag. It's the one number they can't shrink, because
